slice_results.behavior_summary: When called, the code performs multiple HTTP GET requests using the fetch API to hardcoded URLs under the domain npmjs.com (e.g., https://www.npmjs.com/~${name}, https://www.npmjs.com/package/${title}, https://www.npmjs.com/browse/depended). It accesses network resources to retrieve HTML content related to user profiles, package information, dependencies, and popular packages, then processes this data via parsers. This behavior enables automated data collection from a trusted external source, facilitating information gathering but does not directly perform exfiltration or system modification.
slice_results.explanation: [LLM Judgment: Benign] The analyzed code performs HTTP GET requests to well-known, trusted URLs under the npmjs.com domain to retrieve public HTML content related to user profiles, package information, and dependencies. It uses standard fetch API calls and then processes the retrieved HTML with parsers. There is no evidence of sensitive data collection from the local system, no outbound POST requests to attacker-controlled domains, no use of OS or child_process modules for reconnaissance or exfiltration, and no obfuscation or system manipulation. Compared to the known malicious patterns, which involve collecting sensitive host information or filesystem data and exfiltrating it to suspicious endpoints, this code's behavior is benign and consistent with legitimate data gathering from a public web resource.

This code does not exhibit any of those behaviors or use any suspicious modules like os, child_process, https, or dns. The similarity to known malicious patterns is very low, as this code is a straightforward data extraction utility with no side effects or security-sensitive operations.

detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: Monitor npm package installations for preinstall scripts that access system information (username, hostname, public IP) and initiate outbound network requests to external domains, especially Discord webhooks or non-standard endpoints like hits.dwyl.com.
